verdict.rationale: Edge0 uses 4-bit quantized weights, with LoRA adapters distilled from the FP teacher to recover quantization loss (edge0-gh-3), which reduces memory footprint. The documented memory savings come mainly from SSD expert offload rather than a selectable range of integer bit-widths. missing for 10: very low-bit (2–3-bit) formats, 8-bit format, user-selectable precision options, quantization documentation and memory benchmarks per bit-width, independent corroboration.
